description: Stomify is a desktop application for automated stomatal counting and stomatal density measurement from leaf epidermal impressions. It uses a YOLOv8m deep learning model (Ultralytics) trained on maize leaf impressions imaged with a light microscope at 10x magnification. The published software record with the trained model and Windows installer is available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23319544.
